  Agile Software Development for Engineers [IT-4308]  
  Marks: 50                                                                              Duration: 180 mins.  
  PART-A  
  Answer all the questions.  
  1)           In what ways does the Kanban system assist in managing and optimizing workflow  
  within a team? Furthermore, what role do Work in Progress (WIP) limits play in this  
  (5)  
  process?  
  A)  
  B)      In what ways can virtual meetings enhance the evaluation of Agile methodologies in  
  distributed startup teams using Scrum methodology.                                            (5)  
  
  2)           How can Agile teams strike a balance between delivering working software and  
  maintaining appropriate documentation?  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Evaluate the effectiveness of Agile scaling frameworks such as SAFe (Scaled Agile  
  Framework) or LeSS (Large-Scale Scrum) in addressing the challenges of coordinating           (5)  
  multiple Agile teams within large organizations.  
  
  3)           Illustrate the process of scrum framework with an example.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Illustrate the possible combinations of pair programming in software development life  
  cycle.                                                                                        (5)  
  
  4)           Critically evaluate two Agile project management tools (e.g., Jira vs. Azure DevOps) in  
  terms of scalability and team collaboration.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Design a stakeholder engagement plan for a product with evolving requirements and  
  multiple end-user groups. How will you gather feedback and incorporate it iteratively?        (5)  
  
  5)           Discuss the influence of DevOps adoption on Agile delivery performance. Which key  
  performance indicators (KPIs) reflect the success or failure of this integration, and why?  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Describe your approach to coordinating sprint planning and backlog grooming when              (5)  
  several Agile teams depend on a shared product backlog. How do you ensure strategic
